git_anchor.note: The landing record and master are uncommitted control-plane files; a later manual commit supplies the landing commit identity.

native_validation.m7_deferred_reason: Exact HSR 4.4.54 official native runtime artifact/capture is unavailable; engineering baseline may land without weakening Golden qualification.
native_validation.m7_re_entry_condition: A future exact HSR 4.4.54, provenance-qualified, independent native artifact satisfying the existing OracleRegistry qualification contract.

freeze_rule.baseline: HSR 4.4.54 runtime and semantic behavior is frozen as the engineering baseline.
permitted_change_paths: An explicit CR may fix a local implementation bug without a new semantic-evidence claim.
New exact HSR 4.4.54 provenance-qualified evidence may reopen the applicable semantic domain or M7 through the existing evidence process.
A later-version delta belongs in a new version namespace with an explicit diff/migration.
freeze_rule.later_version_policy: HSR 4.4.54 remains an immutable baseline; later versions require an explicit diff/migration and cannot silently backfill 4.4.54.

forbidden_claims: native optimality from local planner data
Golden without a qualifying independent exact-version native oracle
NATIVE_TRACE without a qualifying native trace
close-version or private-server evidence satisfying M7
